summary: Tested new default_taxatie_fee + existing default_fee feature on /api/customers and the Klantenbestand + Taxatie Facturen UI flow. 11/11 backend tests pass and the full frontend integration flow works as expected: customer creation with both fees, inline edit, auto-fill of taxatie_items.fee and extra_fee on customer pick, combined toast message, and default €160 retention when customer has no override.
critical_code_review_comments: customers.py upsert match-key: when an existing customer is edited via POST with the SAME phone, match works; but if phone changes between calls a new doc is upserted instead of updating the original (low risk since UI sends the original phone with the inline editor).

Inline editor in CustomerDirectory sends the full customer payload (name, phone, email, address, city) — fine because backend upsert uses (created_by, name_slug, phone) for matching, so the existing record is correctly updated.
Frontend `pickCustomer` uses `if (c.default_taxatie_fee && Number(c.default_taxatie_fee) > 0)` which is correct — a cleared (null/0) fee will not overwrite items.
Minor UX: when invoice_type === 'fee_only' the taxatie_items fee is not visible in UI, but pickCustomer still overwrites it. Harmless because totalFee is forced to 0 in handleCreate for fee_only.
